findings.title: Shard-aware "missed target shard" branch drops connection without dec_total_connections()
findings.claim: In handle_ready_connection, the else if evt.requested_shard.is_some() branch calls start_opening_connection(None) and drops the connection without decrementing total_connections, causing the metrics gauge to drift upward each time this occurs; no test covers this path.

findings.title: Keyspace setup failures now logged only at debug!, losing visibility
findings.claim: The removed warn! in start_setting_keyspace_for_connection was the only visible signal of a persistent USE failure; a non-empty pool that keeps failing to grow would show nothing at default log levels.

findings.title: Keyspace-failure branch behaves differently from Connection error branch without…
findings.claim: The Connection error branch falls back to the non-shard-aware port when requested_shard.is_some(), but the new Keyspace branch instead sets had_error_since_last_refill and waits for backoff; this may be defensible but the PR description doesn't state it's intentional, and the existing test only asserts the refill flags rather than this distinction.

findings.title: keyspace_setup_failure_preserves_pool_state test covers three scenarios in one ~130-line…
findings.claim: The test covers the initial connection, a failed USE, and a successful USE, relying on a mutable proxy rule set plus a manual event pump, making failures hard to localise; splitting it into separate tests would help.

findings.title: Whether PoolRefiller teardown should decrement total_connections for still-live…
findings.claim: It's unclear whether connections still live when a PoolRefiller is dropped should decrement the metric; the reviewer did not look at teardown.

findings.title: Whether debug! vs warn! log level change matches upstream convention
findings.claim: It's unclear whether the log level change matches upstream logging conventions; this was not investigated.

findings.title: Possible unused-import warnings under --no-default-features (non-metrics build)
findings.claim: There may be unused-import warnings when building without the metrics feature; this was judged only by reading, not by compiling.

findings.title: No changelog entry appears in the diff
findings.claim: No changelog entry appears in the diff, and the reviewer doesn't know whether the project keeps one.
